title: Theme-aware block palettes — variant builders parameterised by ArenaTheme
notes: Connects S171 themes with S165 block variants. Previously the theme only tinted the floor entity; hard + soft blocks ignored the theme palette (used hard-coded #7a7570 / #a08055 constants). Now buildHardBlockVariant + buildSoftBlockVariant accept an optional palette argument; the kaboom mesh-sync bridge encodes the active theme key in the procedural mesh seed (procedural:kaboom-hard-block-0#factory etc.) so the procedural-mesh-registry caches one BufferGeometry per (variant, theme) tuple.

Default palette falls back to the legacy constants (backwards compat) — calling buildHardBlockVariant(0) without a palette produces identical geometry to before. Shadow + seam tints are derived from primary if only primary is provided (Color.multiplyScalar fallback).

Live probe with ?theme=factory confirmed: soft blocks render rusty orange-red (factory softBlockPalette), hard blocks render warm dark grey (factory hardBlockPalette). Floor tints to factory floorPrimaryHex via the existing S171 theme-apply system.

stories.title: buildHardBlockVariant + buildSoftBlockVariant accept optional palette
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/blocks/hard-block-variants.ts + soft-block-variants.ts. New HardBlockPalette / SoftBlockPalette types. Signature: build...(index, palette?, bitmask?). Default palette uses existing constants (back-compat). Shadow + seam auto-derive from primary via Color.multiplyScalar when not explicitly supplied.
verification: acceptance: 8 new theme-palette tests pass — default palette matches legacy constants, explicit primary changes color attribute sum, distinct primaries produce distinct geometries, bitmask still accepted as third arg.

stories.title: Mesh-sync bridge encodes theme in procedural seed; registry caches per (variant, theme)
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/block-variant-system.ts — mesh-sync writes 'procedural:kaboom-hard-block-N#themeKey'. Reads ArenaTheme.themeKey from kaboom.game-state (default 'warehouse'). Cache key per-cell is now (variant, theme) so a theme change re-writes the mesh ref. examples/kaboom-crew/src/register-block-builders.ts — per-variant builders parse the seed for a known theme key and look up ARENA_THEMES[key].hardBlockPalette / softBlockPalette.
verification: acceptance: live ?theme=factory probe shows mesh refs like 'procedural:kaboom-soft-block-0#factory' on 8 cells; screenshot confirms rusty orange-red soft blocks + warm dark grey hard blocks; existing wang-integration tests updated to accept optional #seed suffix.
